description: Pretrained models, Dr. Luitel's request of 2026-10-12: HuBERT Base (facebook/hubert-base-ls960), frozen, pretrained on unlabeled speech (no transcripts), each of its 13 layers' mean frame vector per utterance with an SVM (rbf, class-balanced, per-speaker z-scores, C and gamma chosen on validation), under three classes, pooled random folds (the data section of threeblock_classes_no_neu3_pooled). Seed 1. How it is read is fixed in RULE_night19b.txt (analyses/night19b_prep_20261019) before any run. Runs on CPUs in the classical environment.
